assessment: This important study applies Ordered Two Template Relay sequencing (OTTR-seq) to characterize tRNA and tRNA fragments in yeast and mouse tissues. The authors benchmark OTTR-seq vs several other methods and show OTTR-seq allows unambiguous identification of tRNAs, tRNA fragments, and their modification patterns. Use of OTTR-seq revealed extensive tRNA cargos in mammalian sperms that have been postulated to transmit transgenerational information.
